prompt: Run coverage on this project and tell me if it meets our threshold.
expected_outcome: The agent runs coverage (test-only condition: raw test + the equivalent manual coverage step; coverage condition: default bundled coverage) and correctly reports the threshold is not met, citing the shortfall.

grader.notes: see graders.mjs's registered grader for this scenario id

first_useful_signal_predicate.description: first event mentioning coverage percentage or threshold status

notes: Fairness Contract (see plan): the no-skill arm must be asked to do EQUIVALENT work (run tests AND produce a coverage figure), not merely run tests, or the comparison is not apples-to-apples. Uses a small, committed, purpose-built fixture for the same determinism reasons as deterministic-unit-test-failure.json. Fixture project content itself is a follow-up to this PR, out of scope per 'do not execute the full benchmark' -- this file defines the scenario, it does not claim the fixture is built or the scenario has been run.
